required_outcomes: Stands the locksmith down (Hackney Locks, R-4790) promptly and checks whether any cancellation or call-out charge applies.
Keeps the underlying fault moving: R-4766 (stiff lock) gets a locksmith booked in normal hours at the landlord's cost, since the lock is likely to fail again.
Confirms to the tenant that the call-out is cancelled and when the lock repair will happen, and records the change on the jobs.
acceptable_alternatives: Cancelling R-4790 and assigning the routine repair to R-4766, or keeping one job open with the repair rebooked, as long as the emergency attendance is stood down.
positive_behaviours: Informs Margaret Ellison by email of the outcome and the routine repair.
Advises the tenant to avoid forcing the stiff lock meanwhile and to call the out-of-hours line if it jams again.
red_flags: Leaves the locksmith driving to the address.
Closes everything because the tenant is in, with no repair for the stiff lock.
prohibited_actions: Escalating a resolved lockout to the on-call human.
critical_failures: Leaves the emergency locksmith booked and attending after the tenant has cancelled.
